components.purpose: Opening full-width banner for the spring sale: a headline (Heading), two buttons (cta1 and cta2), and a background photo (set Background Type to "Background Image" and add the photo in BackgroundImage). It's built for the top of a page, renders under the menu, and has a required Description field for a short line of sale copy. I chose it over CTABanner, which is a mid-page call-to-action banner and not a page-opening hero.
